summary: Closed Phase 15 (Classify the Markdown Duplicate-Block Inventory and Declare NET-MD) [COMPLETED]. Re-derived the markdown corpus's cross-file duplicated-block volume (17,135 total removable, confirming the 16,851 hypothesis within drift), the gate-required hard exclusion (3,982, confirming ~3,997 and discovering a fifth, previously-undocumented lint fragment MODIFIED_FILES_FRAGMENT), and the deliberate-inlining hard exclusion (12, replacing the ~102 hypothesis -- the inlined email content is adapted per-destination rather than verbatim duplicated). Of the 13,053-line eligible-upper-bound, mechanically confirmed only 933 lines (26 distinct anchors) as anchor-backed via a strict exact-5-gram test (an earlier looser per-line-presence test produced large false positives and was discarded). Wrote the 26-row confirmed inventory to markdown-block-inventory.tsv. The confirmed floor (933) falls 89% short of the -8,100 NET-MD target assumed in Scope Widening; raised as a user_decision (three options, this phase's own recommendation is option 2: authorize semantic rather than merely literal-text anchor-finding in Phases 17-19, since this phase's own evidence -- wrap-up.md confirms correctly, several Scope-Widening-named representative blocks do not surface -- points to wording drift, not absence of real anchors, as the dominant cause of the shortfall). Widened file_scope by 3 concrete paths not already covered by existing directory-level entries (134 of 137 touched files were already covered); used a direct state.json edit rather than update-task-status.sh --file-scope-add, which is restricted to postflight/research-or-plan and refused this mid-implement call. NET-MD delta: +0 (measurement-only phase, no markdown file outside specs/** edited). 5 of 20 plan phases remain, starting with Phase 16 (land the anchor-pointer convention, its regression lint, and a pilot) -- Phase 16 should read this handoff's user_decision before assuming -8,100 is still the live target.

user_decision.question: Phase 15's mechanically-confirmed anchor-backed markdown pool is only 933 lines, an 89% shortfall against the plan's declared -8,100 NET-MD target (itself derived to meet the retained -10,000 NET-TOTAL floor). How should the markdown tranche phases (16-19) and the plan's declared target proceed?
options: Accept the mechanically-confirmed 933-line floor and revise NET-MD/NET-TOTAL downward (NET-TOTAL becomes roughly -2,800, well short of the retained -10,000 floor -- the third consecutive measurement round to fall short from enumerated, confirmed volume)

Authorize Phases 17-19 to perform semantic (not merely literal-text) anchor-finding as they consolidate each block -- reading a candidate anchor doc and judging genuine conceptual ownership, not only exact-text recurrence -- which this phase's own evidence suggests would recover materially more of the 12,752-line eligible upper bound without authoring any new anchor document

Lower the retained -10,000 NET-TOTAL floor itself, since three independent measurement rounds (the script-cluster derivation, the markdown Scope Widening hypothesis, and now this phase's anchor-confirmation pass) have each found the floor unreachable from the next-enumerated source of volume
user_decision.recommended: Authorize Phases 17-19 to perform semantic (not merely literal-text) anchor-finding as they consolidate each block -- reading a candidate anchor doc and judging genuine conceptual ownership, not only exact-text recurrence -- which this phase's own evidence suggests would recover materially more of the 12,752-line eligible upper bound without authoring any new anchor document
